## What it is

- **Product:** Nabda OTP — **Standard Gateway** (flat unlimited plan path) and **Enterprise Official API** (Meta path), as shown on the pricing page.
- **Operator:** We Pioners Ltd (see About and legal pages).
- **Not:** A consumer chat app. Not affiliated with or endorsed by WhatsApp Inc.
